name: instantnotes
description: Your InstantNotes in a pane beside Claude Code: search as you type, read a note as Markdown, write one in the pane or with /note.

binary.title: InstantNotes program (blank: find it)
binary.description: The instantnotes executable, a name on PATH or a full path. Blank looks for the program the InstantNotes MCP server runs, then what `claude mcp add instantnotes` wrote, then the app bundle, so most people never set this.

db.title: Notes library (blank: the app's own)
db.description: Path to instantnotes.db, to read a second library. Blank uses the one the app or `claude mcp add instantnotes` named, and attachments are read from the folder beside it.
